reason: The kernel's fused 9-tap separable sign-folding implementation was suspected to violate the per-step zero-exterior contract (claim c1). Runtime probes against the contract's FP64 reference rebut this: boundary-delta and random inputs give max abs error 0.0–3.6e-8 (t6), and a full domain sweep over shapes 1x1, 1x129, 129x1, 129x129, 2x3, 127x128, 3x3 at steps 4 and 8 gives max abs error <= 4.4e-8 (t8), all far below the 2e-5 tolerance. Probes also verified x is preserved unchanged and the output is a fresh finite FP32 CUDA tensor of the correct shape (t8). The sign-folding odd extension is algebraically equivalent to the zero exterior for interior evaluation, so the contract's required behaviour holds over the whole legal domain.
